meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会在你做出或改动界面后做视觉质检:截取网页、终端界面或分页文档的截图作为证据,再派两个只读子代理并行核对,最后给出通过/需修改/不通过的判定。
howto.when: 构建或改动任何 UI 之后、宣布完成之前会被调用;也被问「这个页面、组件或 TUI 看起来对吗」时触发。没有可渲染界面时跳过。

say.text: 帮我截取这个页面和参考稿对比,给我通过或不通过的结论
say.note: 会截图、跑 diff,再派审查代理给判定

say.text: 检查这个终端界面的边框和 CJK 文字有没有错位溢出
say.note: 用宽度检查找出溢出与边框错位

say.text: 把这个 PDF 的每一页都渲染成图片检查排版
say.note: 逐页渲染成图片,不看提取文本

howto.what_en: After you build or change any UI, Claude runs visual QA: it captures screenshots of web pages, TUI terminals or paginated documents as evidence, dispatches two read-only reviewer subagents, and returns a pass/revise/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Runs after any UI build or change, before calling it done, or when asked whether a page, component or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Screenshot this page and diff it against the reference, then give me a verdict
Check this TUI for border misalignment and CJK glyph overflow
say_en.note: Runs the width check on terminal text

say_en.text: Render every page of this PDF and check the layout
